note: launchd jobs (label -> class). pane-actor: sends keys or messages into agent panes. state-mutator: changes installs, scratch or OMP state a restart depends on. reader: read-only or project-local; keeps running. Only pause:true jobs are booted out during a fleet restart. An unregistered loaded job whose ProgramArguments (or a script they name) contain a pane-actor signature is HOLD_UNCLASSIFIED and blocks run --apply until it is added here.

com.omp-kit.fleet-watch.why: StartInterval 120; nudges and dispatches into agent panes

com.omp-kit.fleet-flush.why: StartInterval 60; sends Alt+Up/Enter into agent panes

com.omp-kit.scratch-reaper.why: StartInterval 21600; deletes owned scratch whose .owner pid is dead, which a respawn creates

com.omp-kit.omp-watch.why: WatchPaths on the OMP package.json; reacts to OMP installs

com.omp-kit.claude-save.why: saves Claude transcripts; never touches panes
